## Summary

**What it is:** A personalized nursing study plan generator for PN (Practical Nurse) remediation. It reads a JSON file of missed topics, generates a 7-day (or custom-length) study plan that balances client needs, and tracks study progress in a plain JSON journal you can edit on your phone.

**Rules to follow:**
- Standard library + local JSON only (no network, no database)
- **Never include actual qbank content** from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan—only topic tags and your own notes
- Strictly PN scope of practice: reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan
- No gamification features (streaks/leaderboards parked for now)
- Keep 7 as default day count
- Balance so no day has more than two topics from the same client need
- Personal use only—don't package or share on GitHub
